This '''attack''' on [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gruna]]'s [[Gruna's ore hauler|ore hauler]] took place in [[3999 BBY]]. [[Finhead Stonebone's pirate gang]] raided the ship, hoping to obtain valuable [[Ore/Legends|ore]]; however, [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] [[Enforcer One (dreadnaught)|''Enforcer One'']] defeated the pirates.
